semantics: variable regions in the raster-origin inverse encoder (encoder-side search only; no wire-format changes). The REGIONS family partitions the per-frame diff into tiles of a granularity (64 -> 32 -> 16 -> 8), declares each diff-bearing tile's rectangular bounding box as an immutable object holding the target's own sub-rectangle, and paints it above the base with a fresh CreateInstance. Repeated region content is reused by exact BLAKE3 identity (zero declaration bytes). Documented candidate gates: diff non-empty and <= a quarter of the canvas; <= 256 rectangles per candidate; skipped when any changed sample is shadowed by a persistent overlay point (overlay paints above instances). Full mode walks the granularity ladder; Probe mode evaluates the fixed 16 granularity (fixed heuristic / DSFB rotating sweep). DSFB governs the family (active-set Full, otherwise Off with periodic probe).

flag_local_1920x1080.content: structured desktop base; a 200x120 'clock panel' changes content every frame for 40 frames plus a full-width x16 status bar every 8 frames
flag_local_1920x1080.note: frame 0 pays the one whole-canvas base declaration (~2.07 MB); every localized change is a small region declaration, never a whole-frame rebase

reuse_court_160x120.content: 5 clock-change frames then 31 frames where only a 16x16 glyph area alternates between two known contents

fixed_heuristic.note: probe-granularity blindness: the fixed 16-granularity probe splits some rectangles, costing extra creates

rect_shapes_128x96.content: full-width w x 8 banner + 24x24 block + 8x8 cell per frame (rectangular region shapes)

noise_48x32.note: diff gate skips the region family; noise stays RAW with bounded overhead

test_count: tests/phase_k.rs (9 courts); full gate: cargo fmt --check, cargo check --all-targets, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test --all-features (152 tests, 0 failures, dev and release)
notes: No normative format change in Phase K: regions use the existing object + instance model (any box geometry at any placement). Old encoder behavior is unchanged wherever the new family does not win the cost court.

Region instances persist in state: a region stays repaired until over-painted or cleared; long-horizon instance retirement and region+residual composites (dense region with sparse dust remainder) are recorded Phase-O surface.

Candidate validity is analytic (target-exact rectangle content + full diff coverage); the standing invariants still hold: every committed winner is re-materialized and compared with the target, and every stream is decode-verified end-to-end before return.
Oracle invariant asserted per frame in tests: winner payload == min over every evaluated family; region winners pay envelope + 17 B x created rectangles.
